_meta.format: TGA 128x128 (RGB or RGBA), one per country tag: <TAG>.tga
_meta.name_source: eu4 localisation/*_l_english.yml keys TAG / TAG_ADJ; fallback common/country_tags file name
_meta.glyph_note: EU4 localisation encodes macron vowels with substitute glyphs for the game font. Confirmed from 'T‹t‹ P€limu' = wiki 'Tūtū Pālimu': ‹ = ū, € = ā (applied in name_normalised). Other substitutes seen (•, ‡, ’ etc.) are left unchanged because I could not confirm them.
_meta.blazon_note: blazon_seen = what the flag shows, written from viewing a contact sheet of 84 major flags; not official heraldic text.
_meta.name_zh_source: zh/timeline (Chinese community project "哈兰历史地图") dist/data/**/*.json field nameZh keyed by EU4 tag; that project credits the "Anbennar Chinese ver" Steam Workshop localisation (2818493730) for its Chinese names. 1016 of 1433 tags have a Chinese name; where the project lists several names for one tag the first is name_zh and the rest name_zh_alt.
